gaps: Team K is now 3, and 2 of the 3 (Jamie McKee, Kathleen Walsh) are among those flagged as not in the Claude Code role group — check they can actually run Claude Code before build time is lost.
No floor helper is named for solo / no-team participants, although the agenda promises one — Debbie Farrar, Chris McCullough, Apoorva Sharma or Ashley Palmer could rotate in between their slots.
Kashyap Murali (Anthropic) is a confirmed attendee but his role is undefined — floating mentor or observer has not been settled with Jason Bigman.

The automated scoring tool is being built during the event and is needed by the 2:45 PM judging huddle; it will be untested when first used, and both builders are also judges. No fallback judging process has been decided.

One breakout-room name, "Johan De Vadder" (Group C, 5th member), cannot be reconciled against the registration export — every other group reconciles exactly (44 assigned = 44 registered) once that name is excluded.
Sachi Williamson is OOO on event day; Andy Stetzler is named as in-person backup but the exact scope of that backup role is not documented.
The four proposed day-of roles (AV/room lead, MC, timekeeper, registration desk) were never included in the assignment note actually sent on 2026-08-12 — those people may not know they are assigned.

F&B payment mechanism is unresolved: Anthropic could only pay via a credit-card authorization form due back by EOD 2026-08-13, while Sachi separately told Ashley that GF would cover the cost. The contradiction is flagged, not reconciled.
No phone numbers are on record for any of the escalation contacts — Teams is the only escalation channel, and the AV tech is not in the room all day.

The participant environment question is unclosed: participants will be building agentically in the production Enterprise org, and "RBAC-off the hackathon group" was never confirmed to mean read-only production.
The judging rubric artifact created by Xiaoxue Du on 2026-08-07 has never been filed in the project repository.

decisions.decision: Isa Ellis withdrew on the morning of the event; Team K reduced to 3 (Jamie McKee, Kathleen Walsh, Carrie Douglass).
decisions.rationale: Last-minute deliverables. Notified Sachi and PAG by message before kickoff. Roster updated live.

decisions.decision: Build time extended from 2h40m to a full 3h00m via Option B — trim Team check-in and Submissions close from 10 to 5 minutes each and add the recovered 10 minutes plus the pre-approved 10-minute buffer to Build sprint 2 (80 to 100 min). Event now ends 3:15 PM.
decisions.rationale: Jason Bigman (Anthropic) flagged the run-of-show as too tight; Option B stays inside the already-approved 3:15 PM ceiling, so no fresh room-time negotiation is needed.

decisions.decision: Li-Tal Mashiach's Claude Code quickstart kept at the full 30 minutes; Welcome & kickoff trimmed from 15 to 5 minutes to absorb it.
decisions.rationale: Keep the full talk (intro, history of agents, demo) rather than the trimmed 15-minute version, without pushing the day past the 3:15 PM ceiling.

decisions.decision: Headcount locked at 50 participants; event compressed to a 5-hour run-of-show in the 10:00 AM–3:00 PM room window.
decisions.rationale: Nine hours was judged too long; 50 matches the locked catering count and sits inside Anthropic's 50–75 sizing assumption.

decisions.decision: Anthropic credits confirmed at $7,500 applied to the existing production Enterprise org, with a custom spending limit against the synced M365 hackathon group.
decisions.rationale: Regular Enterprise org (not Console, not a separate org) was Anthropic's recommendation; the spending limit caps exposure.

decisions.decision: Demos run as a lightning session — roughly 10 teams at 2 minutes each, work hosted on GitHub, gong-timed.
decisions.rationale: Fits 50 participants into the compressed schedule and reconciles with the four award categories.
